BCCI Plans Grand IPL 2027 Celebrations

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is planning grand celebrations for the 20th edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL) in 2027. This comes as Arun Dhumal and M. Khairul Jamal Majumdar have been re-elected to the Governing Council. Details regarding the auction for the 2027 season are anticipated.
